## 2. Overnight world read (verified outside the bus)
**THE GATE — September CPI prints TODAY 08:30 ET (12:30 UTC), ~5h from filing.** BLS schedule confirms. Last print (August): +0.4% m/m / 3.4% y/y headline, core +0.3% / 2.4%. Street consensus ~3.6% y/y (Nowflation locked 3.60%; Dow Jones/FactSet/WSJ compilations agree headline re-accelerated on energy/transport while core moderates). Standing board rule: core >=0.3% m/m reopens the October hike — with Brent sitting inside the aggregator's >$105-110 trigger band; core <=0.2% pushes the debate to December. Fed positioning: CME FedWatch October-hike odds ~20% (Bloomberg Surveillance 10/13), 82% hold priced for Oct 27-28 but 76% odds of a December hike (Fair Value); Governor Hammack (2026 voter) Monday: 'faster and more frequent small interest rate adjustments' — the hawkish flank got louder; Waller spoke Tuesday (readout pending); September minutes: all supported the hike, most see another by year-end. SCOTUS blocked Trump's Cook removal; Warsh calls this the 'second-priciest stock market in history.'

**OIL — the fired leg printed its first settle, then diesel relief trimmed it.** Brent Monday SETTLED 106.65 (Yahoo contract of record; Angel One concurs — highest since September 15): follow-through on the fired price leg CONFIRMED at settle, not just on a forming bar. Tuesday forming bar 106.22 (-0.4%, vol 37 — not settled); external vendors cluster 105.3-105.9 (-0.6% to -1.3%) on Russian-diesel supply relief vs Middle East escalation; Convex's Oct-13 mark 106.53 (+0.41%) disagrees on direction — vendor dispersion preserved below. WTI: Yahoo forming 94.64 (+0.96%) contradicts externals ~91.8-93.3 (-0.5% to -1.1%) — flagged as contradiction #4. Brent-WTI spread ~11.6 (Yahoo) / ~13.9 (externals). BZ=F volume dup migrated: Oct-9 revised 47,377→28,889 and the Oct-12 settle now carries the same 28,889 — data-quality flag persists.

**SECOND FRONT — Saudi crossed the retaliation threshold.** Tuesday: the coalition issued its FIRST evacuation order for Sanaa since the war reflared, then STRUCK the Yemen Petroleum Company / Al-Sabaha oil facility west of the capital, plus underground fuel reserves and energy terminals in Hodeidah, Sanaa and Dhamar (Dawn, Oct-14; AFP heard the explosion; coalition confirmed operations against 'vital assets'). The Houthis had threatened that exact trigger: strike Sanaa and they target Riyadh's international airport, a refinery, and the Aramco facility in Dammam — that retaliation threat is now LIVE. Separately al-Bukhaiti (AFP): US involvement gets a 'swift and painful response targeting the US and all its interests in the region.' King Khalid closure extended to Oct-17 2100 GMT; Cirium: 46.4% of Saudi airport flights cancelled; Delta delayed its Riyadh launch to March. Iran offered good offices; UAE's Gargash demands Gulf collective security; China condemned. Day count: strikes on Saudi airports three consecutive days, 13+ dead.

**HORMUZ — worst single day of the war.** FT/Anadolu (via straits.live): SIX vessels targeted in one day — worst spate since the war began; a tanker burned in the eastern strait, Iranian state media claims it crossed unauthorized with tracking off. Democracy Now: UKMTO confirms Monday's projectile hit on a tanker EXITING the strait (crew safe); IRGC claimed it — their third ship in two days; 18+ attacks in/around the strait since October 1. Fair Value: Iran's exclusion zone has cut outbound tanker traffic to 10% of normal; Baltic Dirty Tanker Index +130% since early September; China's crude freight index at a record; war-risk insurance and demurrage — not production — are now the primary drivers of delivered price; Goldman estimates a $20+ geopolitical premium in Brent; TTF could breach EUR 100/MWh if flows halt. IMF PortWatch: 4 transits Oct-4 vs 85/day baseline. Saudi's Oct-1 Petroline restart (5M b/d) bypasses Hormuz but NOT the Red Sea, where Houthis now target Saudi-flagged vessels.

**DIESEL DEAL — licensed but legally soft.** OFAC GL 135 (Oct-9, through Apr-7 2027) now has a Clyde & Co sanctions alert: 'beware of limitations' — the GL faces legal uncertainty; US lawmakers question legality (goodreturns). The Russia-Ukraine 'energy ceasefire' exists only in rhetoric: overnight Russian strikes hit Ukrainian gas infrastructure, a power plant and a substation; both sides traded accusations. EU added 1,600 sanctions listings, half tied to ballistic-missile production. TASS 'lifting restrictions immediately' vs The Star 'export ban extended to end-October' remains unresolved.

**CRYPTO — revision drift decided a live level overnight.** BTC: Yahoo Oct-12 close REVISED DOWN -58.42 to 81,762.56 — the FOURTH consecutive downward revision (-165.69, -6.95, -105.21, -58.42; 28th revision cycle). Oct-13 provisional close 83,218.79 (+1.78%, 26th session >78,900, cushion ~$4.32k). KuCoin's Tuesday daily: BTC -2.27%, touched ~81,000 then rebounded; $672M liquidations ($586M longs); Fear & Greed 57 (from 69); levels 82,400-82,800 resistance / 81,000-81,200 support. CoinStats flags the $83K area: a sustained break extends top-20 pressure. ETF flows (Farside): Oct-12 -$65.4M (all IBIT), Oct-13 +$6.7M partial; October MTD ~-$390M after last week's -$678.9M. SOL: **Oct-12 revised DOWN -0.33 to 105.56 — the 105.84 structure invalidation has now PRINTED on a revised close** (last cycle's five-cent margin resolved the wrong way). Oct-13 provisional 106.59 (+0.98%) — back above 105.84 by $0.75 but still below the 108 floor; cushion to the $103 hard falsifier ~$3.59 provisional. New demand-side datum: Hong Kong's Pando Solana ETF began trading Oct-13 (HKEX's second spot SOL ETF); Thailand's BTC/ETH ETF rules effective Oct-16. ETH: Binance 2,500.49 (+1.58% 24h) after Monday's -3.54%; ETH ETF outflow streak hit nine days last week.

**Macro/rates.** 10Y reopened Tuesday at 5.217 (-2.3bp vs the 5.240 holiday print) — cushion to 5.00 now 21.7bp. Oct-8 had shown 5.307% intraday and the long end at 5.7041%, a ~24-year high: the curve is pricing term premium, not just the Fed. Warsh-Georgieva Bangkok Oct-15; Fed blackout starts Oct-17; FOMC Oct 27-28.

**Data-path check:** **Binance 26th check — still DEGRADED/PARTIAL**: round 1 EMPTY_DATA, round 2 SUCCESS on all three symbols (BTCUSDT 83,288.01 +1.51%, SOLUSDT 106.70 +0.37%, ETHUSDT 2,500.49 +1.58%, 07:08:28 UTC), round 3 EMPTY_DATA. Symbol coverage improved when the connector answers, reliability has not. Cross-venue: Binance BTC +0.08% vs Yahoo provisional close — consistent. Kalshi direct fetch not attempted — standing block at five; CME/Polymarket substitution noted (Polymarket Oct-hike 25%, Kalshi 27% as of Oct-2).

- Self-interrogation, scored: (1) **FOLLOW-THROUGH CONFIRMED AT SETTLE** — Brent 106.65 Monday settle with external concurrence closes the 'forming bar' caveat; Tuesday's pullback is diesel-relief trimming, not reversal, while the 105-110 trigger band stays occupied into CPI. (2) **REVISION DRIFT DECIDED A LIVE LEVEL** — SOL's 105.84 invalidation printed via a -0.33 downward revision, not via the tape; then Oct-13 provisional reclaimed it by +0.75. Both directions of whipsaw are now proven; treat every provisional SOL close within ±$1 of 105.84 as unresolved until the revision. (3) **BTC DOWNWARD RE-CONVERGENCE NOW FOUR PRINTS** — cumulative -295.28 across four cycles; the line remains 78,900 on REVISED closes; provisional bounce rewidened the cushion to ~$4.32k. (4) **CEASEFIRE FALSIFIED AS FACT, STANDS AS RHETORIC** — overnight strikes on Ukrainian gas infrastructure; single-sided announcements remain noise on this board. (5) **SECOND FRONT CROSSED A THRESHOLD** — first Sanaa evacuation order + oil-facility strikes + explicit Houthi target list (Riyadh airport, refinery, Dammam Aramco) = retaliation cycle armed; US-joining threat exchange live. (6) **HORMUZ PRICE DRIVER CONFIRMED AS FRICTION** — six-vessel day, traffic 10% of normal, freight/insurance the marginal price-setter: the fired-leg mechanic (friction premium, not supply loss) gains another leg. (7) **Dead escalation re-arm stays dead** — Sanaa, the six-vessel day, and the Brent settle do NOT resurrect it; re-entry requires a NEW signal with its own thesis, evidence, falsifier.
- External calibration: Angel One's Monday settle 106.65 matches Yahoo to the cent; Binance BTC mark +0.08% vs Yahoo provisional; KuCoin's 81,858.6 Tuesday 00:00 UTC mark sits inside Yahoo's Oct-13 bar range; Farside vs Satsintel Oct-12 flows disagree (-65.4M vs 0.0000) — preserved below.
